baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cosmic predicate "light of the heavens and the earth" is re-presented as niche, lamp, glass, and star.
baseline_models.mechanism: The parable compresses a heaven-to-earth claim into nested media: the niche locates, the lamp emits, the glass transmits without surrendering enclosure, and the star supplies a distant visible analogue. One radiance crosses scales through layered carriers.

activation_trace.role: Radiance is the single output repeated across the cosmic claim and the layered apparatus.
What is above and overarching supplies the apparatus's cosmic upper scale.
The lower counterpart completes the all-scale span into which the local lamp is set.
The lamp niche supplies a bounded aperture that locates and gathers illumination.
The lamp supplies the emitting center inside the successive enclosures.
Transparent glass supplies transmission together with protection and optical intensification.
The star supplies a visible celestial analogue inside the domestic-scale construction.
Pearl-like whiteness and clarity sharpen the glass-star brilliance.

changed_reading.before: The opening could remain a bare metaphysical declaration followed by decorative lamp imagery.
changed_reading.after: The imagery models cosmic light as transmissible across scale through a deliberately nested, bounded, and transparent apparatus.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The blessed olive oil almost shines even though fire has not touched it.
baseline_models.mechanism: A stable, growing source yields oil already poised at the threshold of luminosity. Fire actualizes this capacity but does not account for all of it; the neither-east-nor-west qualification also loosens the source from dependence on one horizon.

activation_trace.role: Stable, growing good makes the fuel's exceptional capacity productive rather than merely ornamental.
Pressed olive oil supplies the material carrier in which luminosity is latent.
Near-occurrence holds the oil at the threshold between capacity and manifested light.
Diffuse radiance names the effect the oil nearly produces on its own.
Contact as an arriving effect marks the external ignition threshold that has not yet occurred.
Kindled fire supplies the actualizing condition while remaining distinct from the oil's prior readiness.
Sunrise supplies one directional source from which the tree is explicitly unconfined.
Sunset supplies the opposite horizon, likewise denied as an exclusive dependency.

changed_reading.before: The oil is ordinary fuel that becomes luminous only after an external flame acts on it.
changed_reading.after: The blessed source carries a near-manifest luminosity before contact; guidance can therefore be read as actualizing an already prepared capacity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah joins the parable of light to guidance, parable-making for people, and comprehensive knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The comparison is an operational sign: striking the parable makes an otherwise cosmic claim perceptible, the light becomes a route marker, and guidance directs people by that manifested mark.

activation_trace.role: The struck parable supplies the deliberately constructed comparison that carries the reading.
Making an example visible turns comparison into an act of disclosure.
Gentle direction to a path gives the disclosed image a navigational function.
A conspicuous waymark converts radiance into something by which a route is found.
Human seeing, hearing, and sensing identify the audience-side reception of the sign.
A distinguishing mark links divine knowledge to a sign that lets creatures recognize a way.

changed_reading.before: The lamp scene is an ornamental likeness appended to the claim about divine light.
changed_reading.after: The parable itself is a guidance instrument: it renders a route-bearing sign that people can perceive and follow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with an enclosing unit, descent, imposed limits, and signs that disclose by distinction; immediately before the focus it again names descended clarifying signs, a parable, and admonition. The niche and glass now read as the material logic of that bounded clarity: limits can make light legible rather than oppose it.

activation_trace.role: A high enclosing wall supplies the whole-surah boundary within which illumination operates.
Delivery downward supplies a directed arrival for the clarifying material.
A precisely delimited obligation makes boundary and clarity function together.
Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the explicit epistemic purpose of the descended unit.
The immediately preceding example prepares the focus parable as part of the clarifying sequence.
Heart-softening admonition gives the clarifying sequence an ethical effect, not only an informational one.
The bounded aperture gives the opening frame a local material counterpart.
Transparent enclosure demonstrates how a boundary can preserve and transmit light simultaneously.

structural_cues: 24:1 opens the surah with descent, obligation, and clarifying signs; 24:34 repeats descent, signs, example, and admonition immediately before 24:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, directed descent, fixed limits, disclosure, and an adjacent example; I infer that the focus vessels materialize the same rule-governed clarity. A live alternative is that these are only compositional bookends with no optical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Universal light appears as unbounded disclosure opposed to restriction.
changed_reading.after: The whole-surah frame makes illumination rule-governed: apertures, distinctions, and limits are conditions that render light usable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accusation is verbally thrown, falsehood reverses truth, speech is received by tongues and spreads, while valid claims require knowledgeable witnesses and culminate in manifested truth. Against that failed transmission chain, lamp-in-glass and light-upon-light can model protected provenance and layered corroboration.

activation_trace.role: Verbal casting supplies the uncontrolled launch of an accusation into the community.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the demanded verification layer.
Falsehood turned away from truth supplies the corrupt signal that merely looks communicable.
Receiving and taking up speech supplies the relay action in the rumor chain.
The speaking organ becomes a transfer surface rather than an organ of verified knowledge.
Diffusion and circulation supply the social amplification of an unverified signal.
Truth made manifest supplies the endpoint opposite to rumor's inverted transmission.
Repeated radiance supplies a positive signal that can be intensified layer by layer.
Transparent protection supplies a chain-of-custody image: transmission without loss of containment.
Knowledge disclosed to the knower sets the criterion that rumor explicitly lacks.

structural_cues: 24:4-18 repeatedly oppose accusation, witness, truth, hearing, tongue-to-mouth relay, lack of knowledge, and clarification; 24:24-25 end with testimony and manifest truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal casting, reversed falsehood, relay, diffusion, witness, and manifested truth; I infer an epistemic filtration analogy from the focus's nested transparent layers and assign light-upon-light the role of corroboration. The live alternative is a general moral contrast with no chain-of-custody mapping.

changed_reading.before: Light upon light means only increasing brightness or spiritual intensity.
changed_reading.after: Within the slander sequence it can also mean verified transmission layered upon verified transmission, opposed to rumor amplified without knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: After truth is protected from rumor, pardon removes the punitive trace, forgiveness covers in order to protect, and the accused are separated from the charge and purified from filth. The transparent glass therefore activates a distinction between concealment that falsifies and covering that preserves a cleared person.

activation_trace.role: Erasing the offense and leaving punishment supplies restorative removal after clarification.
Turning beautifully from the offense supplies a social refusal to keep displaying it.
Covering a fault while protecting its bearer supplies merciful rather than deceptive concealment.
Separation from the accusation supplies the public clearing of the protected person.
Purification from filth supplies the cleaned state that pardon preserves.
Glass supplies shielding that remains transparent rather than becoming opaque suppression.
Radiance keeps truth visible while the surrounding vessel protects what bears it.

structural_cues: 24:22 commands pardon and beautiful turning-away inside the aftermath of the slander; 24:26 declares separation from what was said, followed by forgiveness and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erasure, protective covering, separation, and purification; I infer that glass-like protection distinguishes merciful cover from truth-obscuring concealment. A live alternative is that pardon is a separate social command with no bearing on the optical image.

changed_reading.before: Illumination is valuable insofar as it exposes and leaves everything exposed.
changed_reading.after: Merciful illumination can clear truth while restoring protected interiority; some covering preserves light rather than blocking it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entry, sight, disclosure, covering, and even times of vulnerability are regulated by permission, relation, and return at the threshold. The niche and glass cease to be generic transparency: they model visible interiors whose boundaries remain ethically operative.

activation_trace.role: Movement into an interior supplies the threshold action that must be governed.
The dwelling supplies the protected interior domain around the focus's domestic apparatus.
Seeking perceptible acknowledgment before entry makes sensing itself reciprocal rather than invasive.
Permission supplies the gate that authorizes access and whose absence requires return.
Deliberate lowering and reduction supplies restraint on the receiving organ.
Eyesight supplies the human visibility channel that is limited rather than maximized.
Appearing and making visible supply the controlled disclosure side of the distinction.
Covering supplies a material boundary placed across an opening.
Hiddenness supplies the protected content that must not be indirectly signaled into display.
Protected exposure gives a name to timed interior vulnerability.
The niche supplies an aperture whose opening does not abolish the surrounding wall.
Transparent glass supplies visibility with a still-operative boundary.

structural_cues: 24:27-31 regulate entry, return, gaze, disclosure, and covering; 24:58-60 later regulate permission and exposure by time, maturity, and condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies thresholds, reciprocal acknowledgment, permission, restrained sight, covering, hiddenness, and timed vulnerability; I infer that the focus's transparent enclosures model calibrated access. The live alternative is that the lamp architecture and household rules are adjacent but independent uses of interior space.

changed_reading.before: Divine light invites a simple ideal of universal transparency and maximum visibility.
changed_reading.after: The surah makes ethical illumination permissioned and calibrated: one may transmit light through a boundary without granting every observer unrestricted access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following houses are authorized, raised, and filled with repeated naming and praise; their people resist distraction and maintain prayer and giving. The lamp apparatus acquires human maintainers and daily rhythms, so illumination becomes an inhabited practice rather than a self-contained object.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling space supplies the explicit architectural continuation of the niche scene.
Authorization makes elevation and use of the luminous house legitimate rather than merely physical.
Raising supplies a vertical enactment that connects the local house to the cosmic upper register.
Repeated naming on the tongue supplies an audible maintenance of presence.
Praise and worship supply the house's recurrent human activity.
Refusal of distraction supplies protection against interruption of the luminous routine.
Rising resolutely to an affair supplies active maintenance rather than passive admiration.
Specified worship gives the maintained light a repeated embodied form.
Growth and increase supply the outwardly circulating yield of the practice.
The lamp supplies the central object whose social maintenance the following houses enact.
Radiance becomes the maintained output of architecture, rhythm, and disciplined attention.

structural_cues: 24:36 begins with "in houses" directly after the focus; 24:36-38 then name daily praise, resistance to trade's distraction, prayer, giving, work, and increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate architectural continuation, authorization, elevation, repeated remembrance, disciplined attention, and practice; I infer that these are the social maintainers of the focus lamp. The live alternative is that the houses identify only a setting, not a mechanism of sustaining light.

changed_reading.before: The lamp is a complete interior object whose brightness requires no communal enactment.
changed_reading.after: The next ayat inhabit the image: authorized spaces, repeated worship, and undistracted practice keep the light socially present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places three optical thresholds around the focus: oil almost shines, a hand in layered darkness is scarcely seen, and lightning almost takes sight away; a mirage adds convincing but empty sheen. The steady enclosed lamp becomes a calibrated visibility regime between false appearance, insufficient light, and overwhelming flash.

activation_trace.role: A water-like shimmer supplies visible appearance without the substance the thirsty observer projects onto it.
The ayah moves from mistaken reckoning to exact account, supplying correction of projected sight.
Water-like sheen supplies the attractive optical surface that the mirage counterfeits.
Near-occurrence is reversed from near-shining oil to near-failure of seeing one's own hand.
A covering laid over the scene supplies occlusion rather than protective transmission.
Interlocking turbulence supplies moving optical obstruction in successive layers.
Repeated above-ness builds the vertical stack that makes darkness accumulate.
The same threshold construction now approaches visual overload rather than emergence or deprivation.
Lightning radiance supplies an intense, discontinuous flash.
Sudden gleam supplies brightness capable of overwhelming sight instead of guiding it.
The focus use of near-occurrence establishes the poised, beneficial middle member of the triad.
Glass supplies the mediating surface that steadies and shapes brightness.
Sustained radiance supplies the usable visibility absent from mirage, deep occlusion, and blinding flash.

structural_cues: 24:39-40 immediately follow the lit houses with failed seeing through mirage and layered darkness; 24:43 repeats the focus's "almost" construction for lightning that nearly removes sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive sheen, corrected reckoning, stacked occlusion, repeated near-seeing language, and a near-blinding flash; I infer that the focus lamp is calibrated between optical deficit and overload. A live alternative is a simple belief-unbelief contrast without a middle-regime theory.

changed_reading.before: Brightness is a scalar good: more light should always yield more guidance.
changed_reading.after: Guiding light is steady, mediated, and truth-bearing; appearance can misdirect, darkness can occlude, and excessive flash can disable the very sight it seems to empower.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clarifying signs open a straight route, but the route is realized by hearing that becomes obedience; obedience produces guidance, and the later promise gives that alignment a social effect by replacing fear with established security. Light thus names a traversed and enacted order, not merely an inward perception.

activation_trace.role: The straight road supplies the explicit trajectory toward which guidance directs.
Straightness and balance specify the road's ordered geometry.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception that changes conduct.
Obedient yielding supplies the enacted step after reception.
The explicit result "you are guided" binds obedience to arrival on the route.
Delivery of the message supplies the transmissive responsibility that precedes reception.
Establishment and enablement supply a durable social location for enacted guidance.
One condition replacing another supplies the transition from threat to settled order.
Expected harm supplies the condition that the promised order displaces.
Trust and security supply both the receptive posture and the stabilized outcome.
The focus's gentle direction becomes the initiating arrow of the later message-response-route sequence.
The visible waymark gives enacted obedience a route-bearing image.

structural_cues: 24:46 names clarifying signs, guidance, and a straight path; 24:47-54 test whether professed hearing becomes obedience; 24:55 promises establishment and security after fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message, straight route, compliant hearing, guidance, establishment, and replacement of fear by security; I infer a causal sequence from illumination through reception to enacted social order. A live alternative is that the security promise is a separate reward rather than part of the light mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guidance to the light is primarily an inward act of seeing or knowing.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is completed as a traversed sequence: a clear message is heard, obeyed, embodied as a straight practice, and stabilized in shared security.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus's parable-striking to the same root's material actions in the covering rule. It remains anchored in the exact ض ر ب repetition, the niche as aperture, and glass as transparent cover; downstream prose should present it as a formal analogy, not claim that the two uses are lexically identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: God strikes parables in an ayah built from an aperture, a lamp, and a transparent covering vessel.

activation_trace.role: Making a comparison visible supplies the focus's act of mediated disclosure.
Material placement or impact supplies acts that can cover an opening or emit an indirect signal; only the covering side is carried into this analogy.
Covering supplies the mediating material laid across the opening.
The garment opening supplies the aperture over which mediation is placed.
The lamp niche supplies the focus's own aperture.
Transparent glass demonstrates disclosure through a covering rather than by removing every cover.

changed_reading.before: A parable illuminates by stripping an idea bare for direct inspection.
changed_reading.after: A parable may illuminate by laying a mediating image across an opening, producing protective disclosure rather than naked exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it moves from optics into botany, creaturely praise, water, and locomotion. It remains anchored in the focus's heavens-and-earth scope, luminous tree and oil, and differentiated vessels; downstream prose should mark the one-source-to-many-forms relation as analogy rather than an asserted identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Cosmic light is carried by a flowering tree and oil, then directed to whomever God wills.

activation_trace.role: The branch relation between light and tree blossom supplies a living rather than purely optical register.
Tree as rooted origin supplies an embodied source that yields beyond itself.
Stable, growing good supplies the source's productive continuity.
Creaturely praise supplies distinct living enactments of one cosmic order.
Each creature's known prayer supplies differentiated intelligibility rather than uniform expression.
Proportioning and measuring supply the differentiation of forms from a shared origin.
Water supplies the single material origin shared across varied creatures.
Movement supplies the common function realized through several bodily paths.
One interior bodily surface supplies a distinct locomotor vessel among the alternatives.

changed_reading.before: One divine light tends toward one uniform mode of manifestation.
changed_reading.after: One source may remain one while living vessels refract it into distinct forms, paths, and modes of praise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the testing-metal branch of فتنة into the focus's fire contact. It remains anchored in the oil, ignition, touch, and later explicit trial, but downstream prose should frame fire-as-assay as a branch-triggered possibility, not the primary sense of the lamp image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Blessed oil is so ready to shine that contact with fire appears as a threshold rather than the whole source of its luminosity.

activation_trace.role: Ignition supplies the fire event that can reveal what the fuel is capable of bearing.
Oil supplies the material whose quality is manifested under ignition.
An arriving effect supplies the moment at which latent quality meets an external condition.
Near-shining before contact supplies evidence of prior fitness rather than quality created from nothing.
Testing metal and persons supplies the assay image activated by the later warning of trial.
Punitive fire elsewhere in the surah prevents simple identification of every fire with guiding light.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only the lamp's external energy source.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fire-contact can also assay the source: blessed material nearly discloses its fitness before the test, while fire elsewhere may expose an opposite condition.

strongest_changes: The opening and pre-focus frames turn the nested optics into bounded, rule-governed clarity.
The slander sequence makes light upon light available as verified transmission rather than mere intensification.
House, gaze, and permission rules recast illumination as calibrated visibility that protects interiors.
Mirage, deep-sea occlusion, and lightning establish the steady lamp as a middle regime between false sheen, darkness, and overload.
The later path and obedience sequence makes guidance an enacted order with social consequences.
summary.what_was_special: The most diagnostic whole-surah activation was the three-way use of كاد: oil almost shines in 24:35, the hand is scarcely seen in 24:40, and lightning almost removes sight in 24:43. The immediate move into authorized houses and the repeated ض ر ب in the covering rule added distinct spatial and formal readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The epistemic chain-of-custody mapping is coherent but may exceed the intended force of the nested lamp materials.
Protective covering must not collapse divine comprehensive knowledge into the surah's limits on human access.
The ecological refraction and fire-assay models are branch-driven and should remain explicitly exploratory.
